name: company-research-langgraph
written: 2026-10-08, by reading backend/graph.py, langgraph_entry.py and application.py at the pinned commit, before the detector was run on this project (a held-out check: the detector was not developed on it). A LangGraph StateGraph of ten nodes: grounding fans out to four researchers, which the collector gathers, then curator, enricher, briefing and editor in a line. The researcher edges are added in a loop over a literal list. No conditional edges, so no router.
